description:
A team of one with a crew of furballs, building the Space Mission Design Game as a web game anyone can play. Plan a mission from launch to the Moon or Mars with plush explorers led by two Polish elephants, two captains, and a lunar rover, balancing mass, power, budget, data, and communications.

We warmly welcome Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Medium) as a valued member of the team.

The Seattle home and furball family join in, on a visit to North Carolina.
